title: Coinbase Insider Trading Lawsuit Advances Despite $2.9B Stock Sale Defense
summary: A Delaware judge ruled that a shareholder lawsuit alleging insider trading by Coinbase directors including Marc Andreessen and Brian Armstrong can proceed despite a 10-month internal investigation clearing the defendants, citing conflicts involving a special committee member that reviewed $2.9 billion in stock sales during the company's 2021 direct listing. The post Coinbase Insider Trading Lawsuit Advances Despite $2.9B Stock Sale Defense appeared first on Cryptonews .
